senses.gloss: adv. (בר) outside, freq. with prefix מֵ־, opp. אגואי.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 130a:17">Ḥull. 130ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 130b">130ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 2b:3">Ab. Zar. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>למיתב מלכא מא׳</he> for the king to wait outside (of the court-room).
<cite ref="Berakhot 18b:14">Ber. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>יתיב א׳</he> sat outside (of the gathering of the righteous in heaven). Cmp. <cite ref="B01161"><he>בְּרָאִי</he></cite>.
